forecast_protocol: Fixed fitted model; observed completed prior weeks supply history

source_coverage.decision: Treat exported years as complete for panel construction.
source_coverage.evidence_or_limitation: Missing coverage may look like zero demand; completeness has not been independently confirmed.
source_coverage.adopted_for: Member 5 evaluation; no independent owner sign-off

timestamp_handling.decision: Group creation times as San José local wall-clock timestamps.
timestamp_handling.evidence_or_limitation: Naive timestamps do not establish the source timezone; boundary-week assignments may differ.
timestamp_handling.adopted_for: Member 5 evaluation; no independent owner sign-off

coordinate_exclusions.decision: Retain the existing cleaned-file coordinate exclusions.
coordinate_exclusions.evidence_or_limitation: Unlocated reports may differ systematically from retained reports.
coordinate_exclusions.adopted_for: Member 5 evaluation; no independent owner sign-off

fixed_district_geography.decision: Apply the same archived district map retrospectively.
fixed_district_geography.adopted_for: Member 5 evaluation; no independent owner sign-off

geojson_coordinate_system.decision: Interpret saved GeoJSON coordinate pairs as longitude and latitude.
geojson_coordinate_system.evidence_or_limitation: Applies to the archived export, not the native service projection.
geojson_coordinate_system.adopted_for: Member 5 evaluation; no independent owner sign-off

unmatched_points.decision: Count only requests with exactly one district match.
unmatched_points.evidence_or_limitation: Unmatched or ambiguous reports are absent from district demand.
unmatched_points.adopted_for: Member 5 evaluation; no independent owner sign-off
